structural_match: Explicitly a drop-in package for other Django projects ('Drop it into any Django project and get a beautiful, full-featured analytics dashboard') -- a library/addon, not a standalone whole application. Fails the Section 9 'whole candidate application' requirement on its own terms, independent of any other rule.
researcher_notes: Real clone inspected. Genuinely Apache-2.0 licensed with no provenance red flags (unlike eventyay). But: exactly 1 commit in its entire history, created days before this pilot ran -- no track record, no real users, no evidence this is anything beyond a freshly-scaffolded package. Expected admission result: REJECTED as not a whole candidate application, and independently on quality/maturity grounds.
